An [[Obsidian Shard]] is a [[rare crafting  material]]. It is used in the crafting of  [[Obsidian armor]].

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Random [[drop]] from creatures in [[The Fissure of Woe]]. For known creatures that drop Obsidian Shards see [[:Category:Drops obsidian shard]].
* Always drops from the [[Chest of Woe]].
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Obsidian Shards.
** No [[salvage item]]s, [[Trophy|trophies]] or [[weapon]]s currently appear to [[:Category:Contains obsidian shard|contain Obsidian Shards]].

==Crafting==
*Armor
**[[Obsidian armor]]

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Obsidian|Obsidian]] is volcanic glass made of extruded lava high in silica that cools without an organized crystalline structure.
